procedure: choosing and sequencing up to four real local evidence tools in clinical questions; select tools appropriate to the unknown evidence and finish when sufficient. Edit the routing policy only
split: Published 107-task benchmark. Exclude 16 reference trajectories requiring GoogleSearch, fixed before outcomes. Fixed seed shuffle 91 supported tasks into 30 fit,16 gate,45 test. Different source image paths; historically available benchmark, current-run holdout only, no official test-set claim. Every case gets the identical four-tool menu. Question/image only at inference. No reference arguments, transcripts or answers shown to router. Fit may use reference tool sequences. Up to four tool attempts per case; invalid arguments count against budget. Controller generates bbox and arithmetic arguments. Shared deterministic tool results cached per case and full arguments.
primary: Mean tool-set F1 for successfully executed tools against reference tool set. Also strict ordered trajectory, mean attempted calls, invalid calls, blinded text-only model-judged answer correctness, paired gains/losses. Native HCL memory, one SkillOpt edit and at most one format repair. Accept on strictly higher gate F1 with nondecreasing gate answer correctness, otherwise test uses fallback. Four local tools run from prior prepared implementation; excludes search tasks.
